steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow because the case requires an RFQ.
Give the event a searchable title required for publishing.
Replace the default auction stage with the required RFQ stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Create one line item so its minimum quote can be checked precisely.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite several vendors so a minimum across vendors can be calculated.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Verify the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Verify the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Open the buyer's response grid where Actions is available.
Open the buyer actions menu.
Enable display of the best price across vendor quotes.
Check that the best-price result is visible after the action.
Open the QCS to inspect the resulting lowest-bid row.
Assert the QCS lowest-bid row shows the minimum quoted price.
Move to the supplier portal to verify supplier-side visibility.
Open the RFQ pricing round as the invited vendor.
Verify the supplier portal shows the exact best price.
